status: Production log store, readonly shell mount and actual AgentToolHost wiring implemented and independently tested. Root aggregate/UI verification is separate; full upstream shell/runtime parity is not claimed.
scope: Append-only per-chat UTF-8 session logs at shells/<canonical-UUID>.shell.log; exact bytes supplied by ShellService after its terminal-control filtering.
Fixed-owner log writer lock, locally pinned directory ancestors, CREATE_NEW log ownership, same-handle reads and deletion; no directory traversal/reparse/hardlink following.
Restart retains logs; a fork copies current log bytes under a separate owner and does not clone processes. Log cleanup revokes copied callbacks before deleting only that owner's validated files.

Formatted read/ls capture full bounded immutable bytes/manifests and preserve per-call line ranges through FileReadSnapshotStore and AttachmentPipeline; raw QuickJS fs read/readdir use the readonly ToolExecutor source.

AgentToolHost routes shell tools, exact-request cancellation, replacement output preview, dynamic per-round system manifest, workspace change termination, per-chat cleanup/fork and bounded owner-checked watcher queue wakes.

storage.writer: One QLockFile owner per case-folded agent identity; file handles forbid external writes/deletes while open. Profile and ancestor handles remain pinned during lease lifetime.
storage.append: Synchronous append of complete UTF-8 chunks. Explicit flush/close uses FlushFileBuffers; disk errors stop writer and return failure.
storage.truncation: Source-style whole-chunk rejection with one explicit newline [log truncated: exceeded 50MB] newline marker; subsequent appends do not add bytes. stats exposes bytesWritten/lineCount/truncated/closed.
storage.cleanup: Preflight all strict flat log entries and open validated file handles before deletion; unexpected children/links/hardlinks fail closed. Empty owned storage directories may remain.

readBounds.meaning: Reads over a bound fail without returning partial bytes; large shell logs remain available through formatted read line ranges. Logical captures are immutable after log append.

watcherHostContract.ownership: Only an existing watcher session in this host and matching agentId can wake this Engine. Other chat events and unknown outcomes are ignored.
watcherHostContract.deduplication: Per-session retained payload and delivery reservation are recorded before queue/persistence callbacks. Reentrant duplicates cannot append twice; failed acceptance releases only the delivery reservation, retaining the payload for retry. Accepted-event IDs are pruned against retained owned service sessions, so repeated finished watchers cannot grow the dedup set indefinitely; pending failed-save payloads survive session pruning independently.
watcherHostContract.message: Bounded JSON with session_id/title/outcome/exit_code/output, explicitly labeled as untrusted observed data, passed as user context rather than system instructions. exit_code is restricted to an integer or null before bounding serialized size.
watcherHostContract.queue: Engine sendUserMessage(...,queueIfBlocked=true) preserves explicit Stop/failure/restored pause and does not interrupt pending question/approval. Existing QueueCommitter handles durable persistence; rejected persistence is not reported as accepted.
watcherHostContract.lifetime: Watchers are process-local. Host teardown or genuine sole-workspace rebinding closes processes. Context reset does not independently discard persistent shell sessions. No automatic process restart from old log files.
watcherHostContract.retry: At most16 pending events, each encoded JSON bounded to64KiB plus a fixed untrusted-data label. Failed queue saves emit existing Engine queueError and retry with250ms to30s backoff. Successful acceptance removes the pending payload. A full retention buffer reports failure and points to the retained shell log.
watcherHostContract.durability: A successfully persisted Engine queue entry is durable through the existing QueueCommitter. An event whose filesystem save failed is retained only in host memory; process/host deletion discards it. No crash durability is claimed for a failed write.

verification.cases: Append/read while writer open, exact UTF-8 bytes/CRLF, restart, immutable owner readers, owner lock and profile pin, traversal/ADS/backslash invalid direct paths, no-partial bound/cancel,50MiB truncation once, invalid UTF-8 writer failure, clone/delete isolation, hardlink and profile junction refusal.

Actual ToolExecutor exact BOM/CRLF/base64 reads and readonly enforcement; per-call range/snapshot persistence/reinjection and other-agent denial;5MiB shell capture while workspace4MiB unchanged; raw limit/cancel/revocation.

Actual ConPTY + AgentToolHost + AgentEngine four-protocol local-provider rounds create/reuse persistent variable, dynamic system manifest, formatted/read snapshots and QuickJS raw logs; workspace swap and fork logs without processes; selected-session cancel preserves another session; real watcher preserves pending question; paused wake durable queue, cross-agent filter and reentrant duplicate suppression. Failed first queue commit then successful retry yields exactly one queued paused event; deleting host cancels pending retry. Malformed exit code rejected and large Unicode watcher JSON bounded to64KiB.

reproducedIntegrationFix.cause: SandboxHost workspacePath rejected shells/ before the new reader, including cloned logs with no workspace.
reproducedIntegrationFix.fix: Explicit readonly shells/ path routing independent of workspace, plus early write/mkdir denial and updated advertised sandbox contract. All original actual-host assertions retained.

build.guiFixtures: Offscreen Qt; native child ConPTY PowerShell processes use temporary directories only.
build.network: Controlled127.0.0.1 provider fixtures; no live provider or external service accessed.

limitsAndGaps: Shell processes deliberately have the current user's OS permissions; the mounted-log boundary is not an operating-system sandbox for commands.
Windows local drive implementation only; inherited OS ACLs and ordinary user profile protection apply. UNC/reparse/hardlink scopes are rejected.

Raw QuickJS log reads retain existing4MiB/64Ki-character transfer limits; use formatted line reads for larger logs. Glob/grep of shells is not implemented by this slice. Root separately adds owned-session transcript navigation and a borrowed native terminal view.

Cloning is a bounded snapshot of captured source files, not an atomic filesystem-wide transaction. On a clone failure only still-owned created file handles are removed; foreign destination entries are preserved.
Explicit fs flush is tested as a return-path contract, not universal power-loss durability. No crash-resumable partial log append or process resurrection is claimed.

ShellService protocol/live-terminal parsing, input pacing, waits, watcher command execution, Engine deadline and background queue policy are independently owned and reported by the service audit. Passing these fixtures is not a universal zero-defect guarantee.
peerReview: qt_port_review bounded read-only pass over pins/openLog/readAll/clone/revoke/remove found no additional concrete defect; no independent fault-injection claim.
